title: rosa alpina var. intercalaris
intro: Rosa alpina var. intercalaris, commonly known as Edelweiss, is a perennial alpine plant that belongs to the rose family (Rosaceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving wound healing, due to its therapeutic actions as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of Edelweiss include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. By consuming Edelweiss or using its extracts, individuals may experience relief from various health issues, making it a popular choice in traditional medicine and herbal remedies.
